pages.title: Listen for a time to meet
pages.instruction: Follow Ana’s routine and find the plan she agrees to

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: What time do you get up?
lines.audioText: What time do you get up?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I always get up early, at six. I work in the morning
lines.translation: Eu sempre levanto cedo, às seis. Eu trabalho de manhã
lines.audioText: I always get up early, at six. I work in the morning.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I study on Monday and Wednesday, after work
lines.translation: Eu estudo na segunda e na quarta, depois do trabalho
lines.audioText: I study on Monday and Wednesday, after work.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I go to the gym on Tuesday at seven in the evening. Are you free?
lines.translation: Eu vou à academia na terça às sete da noite. Você está livre?
lines.audioText: I go to the gym on Tuesday at seven in the evening. Are you free?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, I am. Great! See you on Tuesday
lines.audioText: Yes, I am. Great! See you on Tuesday.

questions.prompt: When will they go to the gym?
questions.answer: On Tuesday at seven in the evening

pages.title: Tell me about your routine
pages.instruction: Talk about your day and ask your teacher about hers

items.prompt: What do you do in the morning?

items.cue: Choose a day and a time
items.hint: I’m free on … at … Are you free then?

items.prompt: What do you do in the evening?
items.cue: Describe an evening habit and ask about mine
items.hint: I … in the evening. What do you do?

pages.title: Talk about what you do
pages.instruction: Use I with an activity, and I’m with a state

rows.subject: Activity
rows.example: I work. I study after work.

rows.subject: State
rows.example: I’m tired. I’m free on Friday.

pages.note: Say I work, not I am work. Say I’m free, not I free.

pages.title: Say when it happens
pages.instruction: Connect each time expression to the right word

rows.subject: Part of day
rows.example: I work in the morning. I relax in the afternoon or evening.

pages.title: Find a time to meet
pages.instruction: Use the example week to arrange a visit to the gym

pages.title: Kim needs to change the plan
pages.instruction: Listen, find the new time and get ready to reply
pages.message: I’m not free on Thursday evening. I work until eight. Are you free on Friday at seven? Let’s go to the gym then. We can meet there. Please tell me if Friday is good for you

items.prompt: When does Kim want to meet?
items.cue: Say the new day and time

pages.title: Reply to Kim
pages.instruction: Accept the new time or suggest another one

items.prompt: Are you free on Friday at seven?
items.hint: Yes, I am. See you … / No, I’m not. What about …?
